ValidationRule.description: Ensure that Privilege field is populated when setting the status to HC Application Field on Application objects with type ADDP
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND( ISPICKVAL(Type__c, 'ADDP - Additional Special Privilege'), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'HC - Application Completed'), ISBLANK(TEXT(Privilege__c)) ), AND( ISPICKVAL(Type__c, 'ADDP - Additional Special Privilege'), ISPICKVAL(Phase__c, 'H - License Generation'), ISBLANK(TEXT(Status__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Privilege__c)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Privilege is a required field on Add a Privilege Applications.
